Project.NAME: Steam Monitor Web Service
Project.keywords: Steam API, Next.js, SQLite, Prisma, Telegram Bot, Background Jobs, Cron, Web UI, Dashboard
Project.annotation: A highly responsive Next.js web application designed to monitor Steam libraries for a specific group of friends, sending beautifully formatted Telegram notifications whenever a new game is acquired.

M-DB.NAME: Database Layer
M-DB.purpose: Manages SQLite connection and provides Prisma ORM access; Game.notifiedAt records confirmed notification delivery so a game is never treated as known before it is actually reported; User.consecutiveFailures/lastError/lastErrorAt record a broken profile so it stops reading as silence

M-JOBRUN.NAME: Job Run Log
M-JOBRUN.purpose: Records every scheduled run so silence can be told apart from failure

fn-runTracked.PURPOSE: Wrap one cron callback and persist its outcome

fn-getLastRuns.PURPOSE: Latest run per job for UI, API and bot

export-JOB_TITLES.PURPOSE: Russian display name per job, Record<JobName, string> shared by the dashboard, /api/health and /status

export-STALE_INTERVAL_MULTIPLIER.PURPOSE: Shared missed-intervals-before-stale multiplier, used by getStaleThresholdMs

fn-getStaleThresholdMs.PURPOSE: Per-job staleness threshold in ms; free-promos/achievements add their daily off-window length so their nightly inactive hours never read as stale

fn-isJobEnabled.PURPOSE: Whether a job is currently enabled per its own settings toggle; used by /api/health, the dashboard and /status so a disabled job always renders as off, never as an alarm

M-STEAM.NAME: Steam API Client
M-STEAM.purpose: Fetches owned games and app details from Steam API

fn-getOwnedGames.PURPOSE: Fetch list of owned games for a user

fn-getAppDetails.PURPOSE: Fetch details and pricing for a specific game

fn-getAppNameFallback.PURPOSE: SteamSpy fallback to get game name for delisted apps

fn-detectFamilySharing.PURPOSE: Resolve Steam family library support from app categories (supported/unsupported/unknown)

fn-getProtonTier.PURPOSE: Fetch ProtonDB compatibility tier for a game

fn-getCompatibilityText.PURPOSE: Fetch combined official Steam Deck status and ProtonDB tier for notifications

fn-searchSteamGames.PURPOSE: Search Steam store by name or pass through numeric appId

fn-searchDiscountedFreeGames.PURPOSE: Search paged Steam Store free-special candidates for regional appdetails validation

fn-getRecentlyPlayedGames.PURPOSE: Fetch recently played apps that may be absent from owned library responses

fn-getPlayerAchievements.PURPOSE: Fetch one player's achievement progress for a Steam app

fn-getAchievementSchema.PURPOSE: Fetch achievement metadata for a Steam app

fn-getGlobalAchievementPercentages.PURPOSE: Fetch global rarity percentages for achievements

M-STEAMHTTP.NAME: Steam HTTP Gateway
M-STEAMHTTP.purpose: Throttles, retries and caches every Steam HTTP call in one place

fn-steamFetchJson.PURPOSE: Fetch one Steam JSON endpoint with rate limiting, retries and optional caching

fn-steamFetchText.PURPOSE: Fetch one Steam HTML endpoint through the same policy

fn-resetSteamHttpState.PURPOSE: Drop cache and throttle state for tests and scripts

fn-steamHttpStats.PURPOSE: Expose request, cache hit and retry counters

M-TG.NAME: Telegram Client
M-TG.purpose: Sends formatted HTML messages to Telegram, splitting oversized captions, falling back from a rejected photo to text, and retrying transient errors

fn-sendMessage.PURPOSE: Send HTML message to configured chat

fn-postToTelegram.PURPOSE: Post one Telegram API call with retry on 429 and 5xx

M-CBR.NAME: CBR Exchange Rate Client
M-CBR.purpose: Fetches and caches KZT-to-RUB exchange rates from CBR-compatible JSON API

fn-getKztRate.PURPOSE: Fetch KZT rate with memory, DB, and hardcoded fallback

fn-convertKztToRub.PURPOSE: Convert Steam KZ smallest currency units to RUB

M-PLATI.NAME: Plati Price Client
M-PLATI.purpose: Searches Plati.ru for Steam key offers and returns the cheapest top-seller result

fn-getPlatiCheapest.PURPOSE: Return cheapest Steam-key offer among top sellers

fn-marksItselfAsAddon.PURPOSE: Tell a DLC/upgrade listing from a full-game listing that only bundles DLC

M-PRICECARD.NAME: Price Card Builder
M-PRICECARD.purpose: Aggregates Steam RU/KZ, CBR conversion, and Plati.ru data into Telegram-ready price cards

fn-buildPriceCard.PURPOSE: Build unified price card for a Steam appId

fn-formatPriceCardHtml.PURPOSE: Format price card as Telegram HTML

fn-formatFamilySharing.PURPOSE: Render the shared Russian label for family library support

fn-formatPlatiTitle.PURPOSE: Escape and shorten the plati listing title shown in the card

fn-formatWatchlistAlertHtml.PURPOSE: Format watchlist discount alert with historical minimums

M-USERHEALTH.NAME: User Health Constants
M-USERHEALTH.purpose: Holds USER_FAILURE_ALERT_THRESHOLD alone, with zero imports, so the server-side alert in M-CORE and the client-side marker in M-UI share one definition instead of two hand-kept-in-sync literals across the client/server bundle boundary

export-USER_FAILURE_ALERT_THRESHOLD.PURPOSE: Consecutive per-user poll failures that trigger one Telegram alert and the users-page marker

M-CORE.NAME: Core Logic
M-CORE.purpose: Orchestrates the monitoring logic: diffs games, formats messages, updates DB, tracks and alerts on a user's consecutive per-poll failures

fn-pollAllUsers.PURPOSE: Run the main background monitoring cycle; counts User.consecutiveFailures on a per-user poll failure, clears it on the next success, and sends exactly one Telegram alert (=== USER_FAILURE_ALERT_THRESHOLD, never >=) so a private profile or revoked key stops reading as silence

fn-notifyNewGame.PURPOSE: Send one new-game notification and confirm it in the database

fn-buildNewGameNotification.PURPOSE: Resolve regional details and format the new-game message

fn-formatBundleDigestMessage.PURPOSE: Format one digest message announcing a bulk purchase instead of staying silent

fn-sendTestMessage.PURPOSE: Format and send a fake test notification

fn-formatGameMessage.PURPOSE: Generate HTML string from Steam data

fn-formatRuUnavailableKzGameMessage.PURPOSE: Generate HTML when RU is unavailable but KZ details exist

fn-formatDelistedGameMessage.PURPOSE: Generate HTML for delisted/unavailable games with SteamDB link

fn-stripSecrets.PURPOSE: Remove known secret values (Steam API key, Telegram token) from a message before it is stored in User.lastError or sent as a Telegram alert

M-CRON.NAME: Background Worker
M-CRON.purpose: Registers and runs background jobs for library polling, watchlist checks, free promotion checks, and Telegram bot lifecycle
M-CRON.depends: M-CORE, M-DB, M-WATCHLIST, M-FREEPROMOS, M-ACHIEVEMENTS, M-TGBOT, M-JOBRUN

M-WATCHLIST.NAME: Discount Watchlist
M-WATCHLIST.purpose: Checks watched games for new discounts, records price history, and sends alerts

fn-checkWatchlistPrices.PURPOSE: Run scheduled discount checks for watched games, triggering an alert per region (RU, KZ) independently so a game blocked in one region still alerts on the other

M-FREEPROMOS.NAME: Free-To-Keep Promotions
M-FREEPROMOS.purpose: Discovers Steam games with 100% free-to-keep promotions, filters invalid cases, deduplicates promotion keys, and sends Telegram alerts

fn-isFreeToKeepPromotion.PURPOSE: Validate regional appdetails package data as a real free-to-keep promotion

fn-discoverFreePromotions.PURPOSE: Collect paged RU/KZ free-special candidates and validate them against appdetails

fn-formatFreePromotionMessage.PURPOSE: Format Telegram HTML with regional availability and required links

fn-checkFreePromotions.PURPOSE: Run scheduled promotion discovery, dedupe, ownership filtering, and send cycle

M-ACHIEVEMENTS.NAME: Perfect Achievements
M-ACHIEVEMENTS.purpose: Detects Steam 100% achievement completion events using owned-game and recently-played playtime diffs plus periodic full scans, stores progress baselines, enriches messages with SteamHunters, and sends Telegram sunflower alerts

fn-buildAchievementSnapshot.PURPOSE: Merge Steam achievement sources into a normalized completion snapshot

fn-formatPerfectAchievementMessage.PURPOSE: Format a Telegram HTML sunflower notification

fn-checkPerfectAchievements.PURPOSE: Run scheduled achievement baseline and transition checks

fn-selectAchievementScanPlan.PURPOSE: Choose achievement API candidates from tracked library/recent-play playtime changes and stale progress states

fn-findLatestPerfectAchievementForUser.PURPOSE: Find and optionally send one user's latest historical perfect game

M-TGBOT.NAME: Telegram Bot Commands
M-TGBOT.purpose: Runs Telegram long-polling command handlers for price lookup, watchlist management, and job status

export-BOT_COMMANDS.PURPOSE: Registry of every answered command with description and handler

fn-resolveCommand.PURPOSE: Resolve an incoming command name or alias to its spec

fn-buildHelpMessage.PURPOSE: Render the /help listing from the command registry

fn-formatStatusMessage.PURPOSE: Render one line per known job (/status), never omitting a job that has not run; a job that ran ok once but exceeded its own getStaleThresholdMs renders distinctly (💤), not as a stale ✅; a disabled job always renders as switched off (⏸), outranking every other state

M-API.NAME: REST API
M-API.purpose: Next.js Route Handlers exposing endpoints for the UI

fn-HealthRoute.PURPOSE: GET /api/health — ok/stale/failing status derived per job against its own getStaleThresholdMs (previously library-only); `jobs` always lists all JOB_NAMES (never omits a job with no row yet), each entry carrying `enabled` so a consumer can tell disabled from broken from never-run; no credentials exposed

M-UI.NAME: Web Interface
M-UI.purpose: React Server/Client components for the dashboard

fn-DashboardPage.PURPOSE: Main overview with monitoring and notification counts, plus the 'Последние прогоны' job-run panel

fn-describeJobRun.PURPOSE: Exported for direct unit testing: derives a job's off/never/ok/stale/failing status against that job's own getStaleThresholdMs and enabled state; a disabled job always reads off, kept distinct from never (enabled, no row yet)

fn-SettingsPage.PURPOSE: Configuration form for credentials and monitoring jobs

fn-UsersPage.PURPOSE: User management table; marks a user whose consecutiveFailures reached USER_FAILURE_ALERT_THRESHOLD with an AlertTriangle icon carrying the last error as its hover title
